description:
Implement revised PR1 on existing feat/labeling and upstream PR #918 (fork jat10/zaq#7), not split PRs yet. User 2026-11-12 authorized epic, delegated GPT-6.1 Sol implementation, iterative independent PR review, tests, final precommit and push. No merge authorized. Requirements: issue #598 plus https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/598#issuecomment-6705695678 and #issuecomment-6705696617. Full PR1 includes typed definitions, shared assignments, pending automatic configuration, folder inheritance, pre-ingestion identity, existing UI/queries/lifecycle. PR2 retains conversion using existing ingestion pipeline, Decision execution and retrieval representation refresh; PR3 retains chunk visualization and final feature UX/E2E.
Working contracts from discussed plan: definitions separate from one polymorphic assignment table; Boolean, scale(min,max,increment), stable option IDs; manual values required, false/zero meaningful, automatic missing values pending, explicit exclusion distinct. Assignment mode/threshold owned by label definition. Document override/exclusion > nearest folder > higher ancestors. Source identities provider/configuration/record scoped; use canonical ancestry, not a separate tree. Ensure Document on Save transaction, source authorization and source-derived permissions, Cancel no identity/assignment creation, no ingestion side effects. Reject changes invalidating used definitions/values. These are the supervised implementation baseline; report unresolved security/product consequences before inventing behavior.
Preserve existing UI, Action/domain ownership, NodeRouter/Event boundary, version checks, atomic writes and permissions. Extend existing tests and assertions; consolidate duplicates without losing scenarios. Exact old free-text/blank/rejected-auto expectation replacements require requested explicit test approval before edits. No parallel legacy implementation or unrelated refactor. Existing .serena/project.yml edit is user-owned and excluded.
Work serially through implementation dependencies; scoped tests and mix q per issue; NEVER mix precommit per issue. Independent PR review against requirements and base, repair all evidenced findings, re-review to zero unresolved findings; coverage-upper after review; review coverage changes; required existing E2E; final mix precommit only after all fixes before push. Final push updates existing PR branch; no force push or merge. New consolidated feature E2E remains zaq-kw0.15 UX -> zaq-kw0.16, not self-approved. PR1 completion does not close entire feature.

Sequence: zaq-kw0.44.1 -> zaq-kw0.44.2 -> zaq-kw0.44.3 -> zaq-kw0.44.4 -> zaq-kw0.44.5 -> zaq-kw0.44.6 -> zaq-kw0.44.7 -> zaq-kw0.44.8 -> zaq-kw0.44.9
Implementation children have serial dependencies. Audit child is sole initial ready child.
